annotations.title: The team's sites: status, homepage uptime over 1, 7 and 30 days, open incidents

description: Wraps GET /api/sites. The team's sites: status, homepage uptime over 1, 7 and 30 days, open incidents. Call this to compare sites or report on uptime over the last day, week or month. It also lists the slugs every other route takes.

domain.description: only the site on this domain (example.com, www.example.com or a URL; matched by host, without www.): an empty list when the team has none

name: sites

checkFrom.description: where the homepage, nav and newest-content checks run; a failure is checked again from the other location before it alerts or counts against uptime

dismissed.description: of those, how many the team dismissed

public.description: it has a public status page

slug.description: the site's slug: its id in every /api/sites/{slug} route

status.description: its status now: "up", "down", "degraded" (up, with warnings open) or "unknown" (not checked yet)

d1.description: Checks that passed, of those made, in a period

percent.description: ok / total × 100, two decimals; null with no checks

d30.description: Checks that passed, of those made, in a period

percent.description: ok / total × 100, two decimals; null with no checks

d7.description: Checks that passed, of those made, in a period

percent.description: ok / total × 100, two decimals; null with no checks

uptime.description: the homepage's checks over the last 1, 7 and 30 days; null before its first check

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call
